form: One signed lead opinion after plenary review; a common qualification part and severable disability-method discussion; separate Stone-Zsela concurrence in part and in the judgment and Thomas concurrence.
form_legal_basis: Qualification supplies the entire judgment; a separately presented disability-method issue has six frozen non-Stone supporters and requires accurate partial joins. No part or case is divided to change author eligibility or counts.

governing_propositions.Q1-Q4: Exact frozen reconciled program-specific qualification propositions, controlling and sufficient for judgment.
governing_propositions.D1: Individual substantial limitation, ordinary proof and no automatic monocular coverage. Majority explanatory discussion unnecessary to judgment.
governing_propositions.D2: Natural compensation and remaining limitations considered, no categorical disqualification and no general external-mitigation rule. Majority explanatory discussion unnecessary to judgment.
governing_propositions.D3: No final disability finding, regarded-as decision or disability remand.
governing_propositions.T: Thomas additional qualification ground, noncontrolling; common rationale leaves it open.

assignment.basis: Fit: Bragdon authorship demonstrates this opinion’s required separation of individualized disability, actual source-supported federal authority, and bounded safety propositions; Kennedy supports every frozen proposition and its limits. No expansion or commitment change is required.
